_comment: Acknowledged reasons for the Hermes branch being deliberately ahead of the pinned tag. An entry here means a human looked at the unreleased commits and decided NOT to cut a Hermes release for this RC. Entries are keyed by commit, so a commit landing after the decision turns hermesCurrent red again and needs its own decision. Never add one to make a red gate go away: if you cannot state why shipping without these is fine, cut the release instead.

exceptions.reason: rc.5 is the golden RC, so the remaining work is validation rather than change. Cutting Hermes would add a publish plus a pin PR to the critical path of the release we are trying to stabilise and every commit below is either a graft or infrastructure. None is a reported 0.88 regression. The GC graft (14e0378fddb) landed on 2026-10-12 after the original decision and was reviewed separately: it does not change the pin and rc.5 still ships on 260318099.0.4. Re-reviewed 2026-10-13 for rc.6: three further commits landed (b137297d244, 32a1a15b969, 31b0dadae8c). rc.6 was cut for the AssetRegistry TS fix only and does not move the Hermes pin, so all nine carry to 0.89. Re-reviewed 2026-10-15 for 0.88.0: two more grafts landed (30377221e21, adb297cb257). Hermes was deliberately not cut so nothing changes after the golden RC, and 0.88.0 ships on the same 260318099.0.4 as rc.6.
